notes.text: The source proposes limiting later discussion to special erasing or added-marking operations. It describes their action separately on each concerned R_a torsor and writes the cyclic operator group and the twisted-integer definition of Z_a. The overwritten earlier quotient remains doubtful.

For partial uniform erasing, the source writes contraction from Z_a/r(a) to Z_a/r-prime(a), with r-prime(a) dividing r(a). For uniform added marking it writes extension to Z_a/r-double-prime(a), a multiple of r(a). The raised multiplier notation remains d_a versus d(a) uncertain; no mathematical expectation chooses the reading.

The last statement calls partial erasing a strengthening of structure, and says uniform added marking is defined combinatorially without supplementary structural data except the multipliers. The source uses singular le surmarquage uniforme and sera défini. This note records the claim without extending it to all cases.

The raised words chacun, uniforme and ici have visible attachment strokes. The source has no underlining beneath contraction or extension. Surmarquage uniforme is underlined, en a following it is not, and the final partiel has two underline strokes. The crossed closing parenthesis before de multiplicateur remains part of the diplomatic text.

Targeted mathematical check supplied by the main reader: for positive integers r-prime dividing r, let d=r/r-prime. The map [k] -> [d k] embeds Z/r-prime into Z/r. A Z/r torsor has d cosets of this subgroup, hence d possible retained uniform sub-torsors. Conversely, extension of a Z/r-prime torsor T by (T x Z/r)/(Z/r-prime), using that inclusion, is functorial and requires no choice beyond d. This checks the finite cyclic torsor distinction behind the final statement. It does not check the global surface construction or the r=0 case, and it is not evidence for the words contraction or the local d_a/d(a) notation.

H's doubtful renforcement and pas are legible in the strengthening crop. The old crossed quotient is not resolved. The tiny a under the inserted d is visibly lower than d; the possible adjacent parenthesis prevents a secure decision between subscript and argument notation.

The handwritten top number 13 and lower-left folio 56 are transcribed. The lighter footer annotation is provisionally attributed to another hand, without a firm authorship claim. Scan 57 is an editorial locator, not source ink. No independent diagram or pictorial drawing is present.

The original image was viewed once for layout and both prepared halves once line by line, including agreed readings. Eleven evidence places were cropped and directly inspected. The first_formula and singular crops initially clipped boundary strokes; fuller versions were made solely to complete those unresolved boundaries, and both versions are retained. The record cites first_formula_full and singular_full. The count of 27 comprises 21 main text rows, four separate interlinear addition rows and two handwritten number positions. No OCR, web source or TeX compilation was used.

The independent comparison retains the singular surmarquage phrases, plural operator groups, negative pas, future sera défini, and the raised ici. It records the parenthetical Z_a definition as a raised insertion over the old crossed formula, whose quotient and omega-parenthesis readings both remain possible. The two reduced source/target à/colon marks stay explicit, and the visibly separate gommage and partiel underline strokes are represented separately without a new lexical error count. The lowered multiplier a is not regularized from the later clear d(a).
